parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which page: not_found, upstream_error or maintenance

200.description: The page as HTML (text/html), with sample values filled in

404.description: The place shows no page of its own, or the id does not exist

description:
Returns the page a proxy host shows for that kind, as HTML with sample values: its own, the global one or the built-in one, as the host is set. The answer is 404 when the host shows no page of its own (the upstream's answer or nginx's plain page) or does not exist.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)
